description: Damage dealt to Daisoujou is not added to your score. When Daisoujou is defeated, Hachiman's damage taken increases. Stacks up to 4 times.

damageTakenPerStackEvidence.statement: Each stack from killing a minion increases Hachiman damage taken by 10% per stack

supersedes: Earlier note incorrectly transcribed this as four stacks per defeated Daisoujou. Earlier simulator idols had Fire/Ice weaknesses and Curse resistance.
implementation: Live Hachiman applies the pictured affinities and one defeat contribution per Daisoujou up to four total. The later user correction establishes 10% increased damage taken per stack, totaling 40% at four stacks. Apply immediately before subsequent attacks. Stack expiry remains unspecified and is not modeled. No grade-to-stat conversion was inferred from this photo.
